alerts.headline: Nightly from 10 p.m. to 5 a.m. the next day beginning Sunday, Aug. 30 to 5 a.m. Friday, Sept. 4, both directions of the State Route 167 on- and off- ramps at Ellingson Road (milepost 12) will close for utilities work. Expect flaggers directing traffic through the work zone on westbound Ellingson Road.

Starting Monday, Aug. 17, both directions of SR 169 in Black Diamond are closed between Southeast 332nd Street and Plass Road for 35 days for fish barrier removal. 

Separate signed detours will guide passenger vehicles and freight vehicles around the closure. 

Local access is permitted north and south of the closure, but through traffic must follow the signed detours. Businesses are open and accessible along SR 169 during this construction.

iday, Aug. 28 to the morning of Saturday, Aug. 29: Two express toll lanes (ETLs) of northbound I-405 between milepost 17.45 and milepost 18.12 will be closed from 8:30 p.m. - 9 a.m.

The express lanes are northbound-only 24 hours a day through the end of 2026 due to lane reductions for construction on the northbound I-5 Ship Canal Bridge.

The express lanes will operate northbound-only 24 hours a day until the end of the year, to support  Revive I-5 northbound construction.
